profile.summary:
I am a professional Software Engineer with over 3 years of experience focused in Software Development. I thrive in an environment of learning and teamwork where I can grow and learn new technical skills and collaborate with others in an ever-changing technological landscape. I am determined to make a lasting impact in the world of Computer Science and provide cutting edge software to those who need it. In doing so, I am prepared to tackle and overcome any challenges that may come my way.

If you would like to inquire more about my experience and/or share new opportunities, feel free to e-mail me at: thomas.p.harris672@gmail.com.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) provides engineering consultancy services to corporations predominantly in the public sector.

Provided Software Engineering support for mission-critical systems at the Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD), contributing to the development and sustainment of U.S. Navy & Coast Guard ship control systems.

Supported the Platform Independent Machinery Control Systems (PIMCS) framework:
	•	Developed Java-based applications and supporting libraries to deliver a flexible, integrator-ready control system framework
	•	Provided extensive code coverage through unit and integration tests with automated CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and GitLab
	•	Followed hybrid Agile/Waterfall development practices through effective use of Jira and Git version control
	•	Contributed to core system components including alarm management, ballast tank monitoring, maintenance panels, and device/signal data handling
	•	Collaborated with Integrators who extend the framework with platform-specific functionality prior to fleet deployment
	•	Implemented and refined systems engineering processes using existing artifacts, development materials, and documentation standards

Supported LPD-17 Engineering Control Systems (ECS):
	•	Maintained and enhanced legacy ECS applications currently deployed across active U.S. Navy vessels
	•	Utilized ROSE and PageBuilder within a Windows XP environment for system configuration and front-end development
	•	Authored Software Design Documents (SDDs) and Test Procedures supporting system enhancements and modifications
	•	Performed integration and testing of signal communications with Remote Terminal Units (VRTUs), including low-level Modbus bitwise communication
	•	Contributed to system development using the Ada programming language
	•	Supported on-site system installation aboard USS LPD-26 (USS John P. Murtha) at Naval Base San Diego (September 2024)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Java Swing · Java AssertJ · Apache Velocity · Git · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Wireshark · VMware · Jira · ECS/PIMCS PageBuilders · C++ · Engineering Control Systems · ROSE · Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) · Ada programming · Modbus · Windows XP

positions.title: Software Engineer & Team Member
positions.description:
Team-oriented software engineering projects as part of Capstone requirement at the University of Delaware.

QRVision (Fall 2022): Built backend support for redeemable points system. Users scan QR codes in local state parks in Northern Delaware and use points for rewards provided by sponsors. Some sponsors include UD Athletics and UDairy.

TA Automation (Spring 2023): Automated responsibilities for Teaching Assistant (TA) onboarding and management at the University of Delaware Dept. of Computer & Information Sciences. Some of these tasks include manually filing paperwork, moving said paperwork through Human Resources, and TA's being paid on-time. A pipeline for onboarding a given student was constructed as the core element of this project. Criminal background checks and backlogging TA hours were some of the main points in this pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · HTML · JavaScript · Agile Methodologies · FastAPI · Agile Application Development · Pandas (Software) · Discord · Asana · Git · Google Sheets · Pycharm · GitHub

Work is limited to at most 10 hours per week.
